subject: Is it possible to upload the information from my Shiny App directly to Google drive?

messages.author: 97e377a5531e31ec
messages.subject: Is it possible to upload the information from my Shiny App directly to Google drive?
parts:
Hi,

I built a Shiny-app where the user can fill in information. This information is saved as an local csv file and eventually this csv file is uploaded to my Google drive. This all works when I am running my App on my local R program. However, I'm building this App for a company and they will run this App on a server. Now my question is: Is it possible to upload the information from my Shiny App directly to Google drive? Since it is not possible to save the data to as a local file first when I am running the app on the server.

Many thanks in advance!!
